'''Battery coils''',<ref name="TABS" /> also known as '''Enteched Energy Cells''',<ref name="EGWT" /> was a type of [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] created by the [[Ssi-ruu]]vi. When an individual's life energy was absorbed through [[entechment]], it was stored in a battery coil.<ref name="TABS" /> Enteched Energy Cells powered Ssi-ruuk technology, including their [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer|ion paddle beamer]] weapons<ref name="EGWT" /> and [[Swarm-class battle droid|''Swarm''-class battle droids]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
